title: Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain
body:
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Zehra(s.a) ka dulaara pyaasa gaya maara
mohtaaje kafan hai Ahmad(saws) ka nawaasa
Thaame jigar kehti thi maa'n Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo tashna dahaani darya ki rawaani
Darya ke labo'n par hai teri kahaani
Pyaso'n ka gham apna armaa'n Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Matam jo na hoga hum kaise jiyenge
gar mout bhi aaye Matam ye karenge
Seeno'n me hai jab tak ye jaa'n Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shiyou'n ko mili hai Zehra(s.a) ki duayei'n
Matam me jawaano sab haath uthaaye
Dil se bolei'n saare jawaa'n Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jab shimr ka khanjar chalta tha gale par
Deti thi duhaayi you'n Zainab e Muztar
Kaise dekhu'n Aye Bhaijaa'n Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Wa Hussaina Hussaina Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Ustad e Mohtram Janab Dawar Ali Dawar Sahab
